content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-49. - Construction contracts; when authorized.
content.summary:
No contract for doing construction work for acquiring or improving the project contemplated
               shall be made or shall be awarded nor shall the council incur any expense or any liability
               in relation thereto, except for maps, plats, diagrams, estimates, plans, specifications…

faqs.a:
No contract for doing construction work for acquiring or improving the project contemplated
               shall be made or shall be awarded nor shall the council incur any expense or any liability
               in relation thereto, except for maps, plats, diagrams, estimates, plans, specifications
               and notices until after the provisional order hearing and notice thereof provided
               for herein have been given and had.
(Code 1981, § 27-50; Ord. No. 551, § 19(A), 5-14-1964)
State Law reference—
Provisions in contracts, C.R.S. § 31-25-518.
